Walk in Store Price : $79.90

S156 4K Dual Camera Brushless Drone with Obstacle Avoidance – Fly Smarter, Shoot Sharper 🎯✨

Take flight with confidence and crystal clarity! The S156 GPS 8K Drone is engineered for remote control fans, content creators, and hobbyists who want power, stability, and value all in one sleek flying machine. Equipped with brushless motors and dual 8K HD cameras, , this drone is your passport to breathtaking aerial photography — whether you’re filming cityscapes or just flying for fun.

With a 4.5-inch built-in controller display, this upgraded version gives you complete real-time visibility, even in sunlight. Plus, optical flow positioning, and a wealth of intelligent flight modes make this drone incredibly easy to control — even if you're just getting started.

📸 Why You’ll Love It:

Smooth flight from brushless motors & 6-axis gyro

Front camera angle adjustable via remote (90° tilt)

Optical flow for precise positioning

Dual cameras with 8K resolution for stunning footage

Real-time FPV via WiFi – no lag, no guesswork

One-button takeoff, landing & emergency stop

Gesture-controlled photo & video mode – hands-free shooting!

LED navigation lights for night flying

🔧 Technical Specifications:

Control Frequency: 2.4GHz (stable signal & low interference)

Transmission Range: Up to 100m (control), up to 8km (WiFi)

Remote Battery: 3.7V 500mAh (USB rechargeable)

Drone Battery: 3.7V 1800mAh Li-ion (removable & rechargeable)

Charging Time: ~60 minutes

Flight Time: Approx. 15 minutes per full charge

Motor Type: High-efficiency Brushless Motors

Camera Resolution: Dual Cameras – 8K front cam (7680x4320), 4K secondary

Control Methods: Remote Controller, WiFi App, 4.5” built-in display

Flight Modes:

One-key takeoff/landing

Trajectory flight

Headless mode

Altitude hold

Emergency stop

Gesture video/photo

50x digital zoom

Music integration

Materials: Lightweight high-durability plastic + internal metal components

Drone Weight: 170g

Wind Resistance: Suitable for <10 km/h breeze

Age Recommendation: 14+

📦 What’s in the Box:

✔️ 1 x S156 Brushless Drone and carry case

✔️ 1 x 2.4GHz Remote Controller (built-in display)

✔️ 1 x Rechargeable Drone Battery (3.7V 1800mAh)

✔️ 1 x USB C Charging Cable

✔️ 1 x English & Chinese Instruction Manual

✔️ 2 x Spare Propellers

✔️ 1 x Propeller Guards (set)

✔️ 1 x Screwdriver 

✔️ 1 x 8GB micro SD card 

✔️ 1 x USB Card Reader

📏 Product Dimensions & Weight:

Drone Size: 22.5 x 19 x 5 cm / 170g

Package Size: 26 x 11 x 20 cm

Weight (with packaging): ~0.715kg

🎯 Who Is This Drone For?

This drone is perfect for:

🎮 Beginners – Easy-to-use flight modes with safety features

📷 Content Creators – Capture 8K aerial photos and cinematic videos

🛠️ RC Hobbyists – Looking for serious tech without breaking the bank

🎁 Gift Givers – A fun, impressive gift for birthdays, holidays, or special occasions

👨👩👧 Families – Great for bonding and learning STEM concepts

aiTexts: The S156 4K Dual Camera Drone features brushless motors, dual 8K front and 4K secondary cameras for stunning aerial footage.
Equipped with a 4.5-inch built-in display on the remote and 5G WiFi for real-time, lag-free FPV up to 8km.
Includes GPS, optical flow positioning, gesture controls, one-button takeoff/landing, and LED navigation lights for safe, easy flying.

Comes with carry case, spare props, battery, and accessories for immediate use.

product.desc:
Walk in Store Price : $79.90

S156 4K Dual Camera Brushless Drone with Obstacle Avoidance – Fly Smarter, Shoot Sharper 🎯✨

Take flight with confidence and crystal clarity! The S156 GPS 8K Drone is engineered for remote control fans, content creators, and hobbyists who want power, stability, and value all in one sleek flying machine. Equipped with brushless motors and dual 8K HD cameras, , this drone is your passport to breathtaking aerial photography — whether you’re filming cityscapes or just flying for fun.

With a 4.5-inch built-in controller display, this upgraded version gives you complete real-time visibility, even in sunlight. Plus, optical flow positioning, and a wealth of intelligent flight modes make this drone incredibly easy to control — even if you're just getting started.

📸 Why You’ll Love It:

Smooth flight from brushless motors & 6-axis gyro

Front camera angle adjustable via remote (90° tilt)

Optical flow for precise positioning

Dual cameras with 8K resolution for stunning footage

Real-time FPV via WiFi – no lag, no guesswork

One-button takeoff, landing & emergency stop

Gesture-controlled photo & video mode – hands-free shooting!

LED navigation lights for night flying

🔧 Technical Specifications:

Control Frequency: 2.4GHz (stable signal & low interference)

Transmission Range: Up to 100m (control), up to 8km (WiFi)

Remote Battery: 3.7V 500mAh (USB rechargeable)

Drone Battery: 3.7V 1800mAh Li-ion (removable & rechargeable)

Charging Time: ~60 minutes

Flight Time: Approx. 15 minutes per full charge

Motor Type: High-efficiency Brushless Motors

Camera Resolution: Dual Cameras – 8K front cam (7680x4320), 4K secondary

Control Methods: Remote Controller, WiFi App, 4.5” built-in display

Flight Modes:

One-key takeoff/landing

Trajectory flight

Headless mode

Altitude hold

Emergency stop

Gesture video/photo

50x digital zoom

Music integration

Materials: Lightweight high-durability plastic + internal metal components

Drone Weight: 170g

Wind Resistance: Suitable for <10 km/h breeze

Age Recommendation: 14+

📦 What’s in the Box:

✔️ 1 x S156 Brushless Drone and carry case

✔️ 1 x 2.4GHz Remote Controller (built-in display)

✔️ 1 x Rechargeable Drone Battery (3.7V 1800mAh)

✔️ 1 x USB C Charging Cable

✔️ 1 x English & Chinese Instruction Manual

✔️ 2 x Spare Propellers

✔️ 1 x Propeller Guards (set)

✔️ 1 x Screwdriver 

✔️ 1 x 8GB micro SD card 

✔️ 1 x USB Card Reader

📏 Product Dimensions & Weight:

Drone Size: 22.5 x 19 x 5 cm / 170g

Package Size: 26 x 11 x 20 cm

Weight (with packaging): ~0.715kg

🎯 Who Is This Drone For?

This drone is perfect for:

🎮 Beginners – Easy-to-use flight modes with safety features

📷 Content Creators – Capture 8K aerial photos and cinematic videos

🛠️ RC Hobbyists – Looking for serious tech without breaking the bank

🎁 Gift Givers – A fun, impressive gift for birthdays, holidays, or special occasions

👨👩👧 Families – Great for bonding and learning STEM concepts

🚁✨ Take Flight with the LSRC S6S Mini Drone – Your Pocket-Sized 4K Adventure Buddy! ✨🚁

Ready to explore the skies? 🌤️ Whether you're capturing stunning 4K photos or navigating with GPS precision, the LSRC S6S Mini Drone is built to amaze. Lightweight, powerful, and packed with intelligent features, it's perfect for adventurers and tech enthusiasts alike! 💥

Why You'll Love It:

  1. Cinematic Quality Anywhere 🎥: Capture breathtaking 4K photos and videos with a wide-angle lens and self-stabilized electronic anti-shake. Say goodbye to shaky shots!
  2. Adventure Made Easy 🌍: Navigate with GPS and Optical Flow Positioning. Enjoy hassle-free one-key return, intelligent follow-me mode, and customizable flight routes!
  3. Fly Longer, Go Further 🔋: With a powerful 7.4V 1600mAh battery, enjoy up to 25 minutes of flight time and a control range of 1500m—perfect for long-range explorations.

Tech Highlights

  • Positioning: GPS + Optical Flow for precise control 🌎
  • Motor: 1503 Brushless Motor with 2200/KV power 💪
  • Camera: Wide-angle 4K HD with 50X Zoom 🎯
  • Flight Time: About 25 minutes ⏱️
  • Control Distance: 1500m (free of interference) 🚀
  • Weight: 160g—no registration required in most countries! 📜

Features at a Glance:

✅ GPS Positioning & One-Key Return ✅ Real-Time 5G WiFi Image Transmission ✅ Adjustable Camera (90°-180° Tilt) ✅ Intelligent Follow-Me & Route Planning ✅ Lightweight Design—Perfect for Travel

What’s in the Box? 📦

  • 1 x LSRC S6S Mini Drone
  • 1 x Remote Controller
  • 2 x 7.4V 1600mAh LiPo Batteries 
  • 4 x Spare Propellers
  • 1 x USB Charging Cable
  • 1 x Screwdriver
  • 1 x User Manual
  • 1 x Mobile Phone Bracket

Specifications:

  • Drone Size: 19 x 13 x 4 cm
  • Drone Take-off Weight: 160g
  • Charging Time: ~2 Hours
  • Max Phone Clip Size: 5.5 inches
  • Package Size & Weight: 22 x 18 x 7 cm / 581g

🛒 Ready to Elevate Your Adventures? Don't miss out on this high-performance mini drone that packs a punch!

1: Fully enclosed, propeller safe design, compact size, easy to carry.
2: The drone has a fixed altitude maintenance mode function, built-in three sided sensing obstacle avoidance, electrically adjustable , and can achieve 180 ° upward shooting, optical flow fixed-point positioning, and stable flight.
3: In headless mode, there is no need to determine the direction of the aircraft during flight.
4: By using the one click return function, you can easily find your way home.
5: 4K/6K/8K pixel high-definition camera, capable of capturing stunning photos and videos from the air.
6: Equipped with WiFi function, it can connect applications and APP systems, take photos and videos, and transmit real-time images through the phone camera.
7: Draw the flight path on the screen, and the drone will autonomously fly along the specified path.
8: 2.4GHz anti-interference technology.
9: There are four channels: ascending, descending, advancing, retreating, flying left, flying right, and rolling.
10: Six axis gyroscope for smoother flight and easier control.

1 D16 drone

1: Fully enclosed, propeller safe design, compact size, easy to carry.

2: The drone has a fixed altitude maintenance mode function, built-in three sided sensing obstacle avoidance, electrically adjustable lens, and can achieve 180 ° upward shooting, optical flow fixed-point positioning, and stable flight.

3: In headless mode, there is no need to determine the direction of the aircraft during flight.

4: By using the one click return function, you can easily find your way home.

5: 4K/6K/8K pixel high-definition camera, capable of capturing stunning photos and videos from the air.

6: Equipped with WiFi function, it can connect applications and APP systems, take photos and videos, and transmit real-time images through the phone camera.

7: Draw the flight path on the screen, and the drone will autonomously fly along the specified path.

8: 2.4GHz anti-interference technology.

9: There are four channels: ascending, descending, advancing, retreating, flying left, flying right, and rolling.

10: Six axis gyroscope for smoother flight and easier control.

Function: Up/Down/Front/Rear, Left/Right Turn, Lateral Flight, LED Light, 360 ° Stunt Roll, Headless Mode, One Click Auto Return, Height Maintenance Mode WiFi FPV, Dual Camera Switchable, Supports Landscape/Portrait/Head Up Shooting, Camera Electric Adjustable 180 °

1 D16 drone

13808260619.detail_html:
Features:

* 4.3-inch Large Screen Remote Controller: No need to connect to a mobile phone; simply power on and start flying. Intuitive operation and clear real-time display allow for easy drone control.

* High-Definition Camera: A 4K (480P) high-definition camera captures stunning aerial photos and videos, restoring true details. Supports horizontal, vertical, and overhead shooting, as well as dual-lens switching, adapting to different shooting scenarios.

* Image Transmission: 2.4G WiFi transmission ensures stable signal and a transmission distance of up to 40 meters. Aerial footage can be viewed in real-time on your mobile phone. WiFi connectivity allows connection to applications and apps for taking photos, videos, and real-time transmission via your phone's camera.

* Three-Sided Obstacle Avoidance: Intelligent obstacle avoidance technology automatically identifies and avoids obstacles in front, to the left, and to the right, effectively reducing the risk of collisions and ensuring the safety of novice pilots.

* 180° Motorized Adjustable Lens: Supports free switching between vertical and horizontal shooting, flexibly adjusting the shooting angle to capture more aerial perspectives.

* Optical Flow Positioning & Altitude Hold: Stable hovering without drift ensures clear and stable aerial photos and videos, allowing even beginners to easily create beautiful works.

* All-around propeller protection: Fully enclosed propeller safety design, scratch- and impact-resistant, effectively protecting the propeller and ensuring safe indoor and outdoor flight.

* External light assembly: Equipped with LED lights, providing high visibility during nighttime flight, adding a cool atmosphere, and making nighttime aerial photography more fun.

* Mini and portable size: Compact and lightweight, easy to carry, allowing you to enjoy aerial photography anytime, anywhere.

* Multiple practical functions: Headless mode (no need to determine the drone's direction), one-key return home (easily find your way back home), 360° aerobatic rolls, customizable flight routes via the app, etc., meeting your various flight needs.



Packing included:

1 * Drone

1 * 4.3-Inch Screen Remote Controller

1 * Body Battery

1 * Memory Card

1 * Card Reader

4 * Spare Propeller Blade

1 * USB Charging Cable

4 * Wrench

2 * Instruction Manual

product.highlights:
With three dazzling colored lights, your flying ball toy will look like a neon shooting star when you launch it across the sky.
It's easy to get started with the ball toy. Turn on the power button and hold the toy upwards, then simply shake to start and give it a toss!
Launches your toy, then call it right back to home base - that is your hand - with The Boomerang. Toss the spining toy into the air, and watch as it circles right back to you. Catch it in one hand and be ready to launch your next trick.
The toy ball can spin ultra-fast while hovering in place. Put your hand underneath the ball and follow the spining orb as long as you can, for the feeling that you're redefining gravity. Who said magic wasn't real?
Go freestyle as you hover, glide, and pass the toy ball and forths. Make things even more interesting by spicing up your catches and passes with different moves.
